Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
